description: Defines a custom Android Button class 'AnticiButton' that applies skew transformations and animated behaviors to simulate anticipation and follow-through effects in UI interactions.

classes.name: AnticiButton
classes.description: A custom Button that can be skewed and animated to depict anticipation and follow-through effects, handling its own draw and touch interactions.

methods.name: getSkewX
methods.description: Returns the current skew value applied to the button.

methods.name: setSkewX
methods.description: Sets the skew amount for the button, invalidating its shape and appearance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the button, setting touch and click listeners.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Overrides the default draw method to apply skew transformations via Canvas before drawing the button.

methods.name: runPressAnim
methods.description: Starts an animation creating a skew anticipation effect when the button is pressed.

methods.name: runClickAnim
methods.description: Performs a sequence of animations to simulate anticipation, movement, and wobbling upon button click.

methods.name: runCancelAnim
methods.description: Resets the skew and cancels ongoing animations if the interaction is canceled.

methods.name: invalidateSkewedBounds
methods.description: Invalidates the correct region of the parent view to account for skew transformations.
